snippet.title: Slaymeji: Roguelite Desktop Survivor - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Slaymeji: Roguelite Desktop Survivor is OUT NOW in Early Access on Steam! ⚔️🔥

Fight endless waves, create powerful builds, unlock upgrades, and grow stronger with every run.

Slaymeji runs directly on your desktop, so you can keep playing while browsing, working, watching videos, or doing other things on your PC.

🎮 Available now on Steam
🔥 20% launch discount

Add Slaymeji to your library and start your run today!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4879170/Slaymeji_Roguelite_Desktop_Survivor/

#Slaymeji #Roguelite #IndieGame #Steam #SurvivorLike #BulletHeaven
